messages:
Sam K: Moonshift capacity check — quick pulse before I head out. AMS spot headroom low (~8% equiv for p3 instance types). AMER pool healthy (~68%). APAC prewarm showing ~22%. Posting short snapshot from the dashboard below.

Sam K: dashboard snapshot -> AMS: 8% | AMER: 68% | APAC: 22% (tokenized requests spike at 02:00 UTC)

Lee P: ack. Which workloads are draining AMS?

Sam K: embeddings-batch ramped up overnight; noisy tail on `embeddings-worker` pods. Saw sustained queue growth from 01:50–02:20 UTC.

Sam K: quick diagnostic command I ran:
```
kubectl -n embeddings top pods --sort-by=cpu | head -n 10
# shows 3 pods ~95% GPU mem each, rest ~20%
```

Nora: I can open a 2hr transient reserved buffer in AMS to smooth the tail. Need approval for reserved nodes (4x p3-type) — cost center INF-NIGHT.

Rajat: @Nora go ahead, :+1:. Create the infra PR and tag me, I'll fast-approve. Keep it timeboxed 02:00–04:00 UTC.

Maya: I'll nudge prewarm policy to bias APAC earlier tomorrow (start 23:30 UTC) so we reduce AMS pressure on the next cycle.

Lee P: any quota blockers if we add reserved nodes?

Sam K: yes — current AMS SKU quota for p3-family is near soft-limit. Filing a quota request is slow; that's why transient reserve is preferred (use existing spare AZ caps). Also putting a ticket so cloud-ops can spike quota if needed:
https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821

devops-bot: autoscaler: added 4 nodes to ams-zone-2 as part of transient-reserve (requested by Nora).

Nora: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8427 (ramp 0->4 reserved nodes, autoscaler override). Tagging @Rajat for approval.

Rajat: reviewing now, will approve in 10m.

Sam K: blockers: need quick approval for PR + confirmation that the reserved pool will be torn down at 04:00 UTC (we don't want long-running cost drift). Also one ask to cloud-ops: if quota request INF-4821 stalls, please escalate through your oncall.

Maya: noted — I'll add the teardown cron in the PR and add a dashboard alert to verify teardown executed.

Lee P: thanks all. If AMS still low after reserve, we'll flip embeddings jobs to use AMER fallback group (quick config tweak). I'll prepare the fallback patch.

Sam K: sounds good. I'm going to follow the PR and watch the dashboard for the next 30m. Ping me @sam if anything noisy.

Nora: taking action, will post when reserve active and when torn down.

Rajat: approved PR. :rocket:

devops-bot: infra: PR merged by Rajat. Transient reserve active.

Sam K: thanks — closing moonshift check.
